name: SELECT city AS `城市`, SUM(amount) AS `销售总
sql:
SELECT city AS `城市`, SUM(amount) AS `销售总额`
FROM cladata.sales_di
WHERE pt = '20260914'
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY `销售总额` DESC
LIMIT 1000

name: SELECT s.id AS `学号`, st.name AS `姓名`, st
sql:
SELECT s.id AS `学号`, st.name AS `姓名`, st.major AS `专业`, ROUND(AVG(s.score), 2) AS `平均成绩`
FROM cladata.score s
JOIN cladata.student st ON s.id = st.id
GROUP BY s.id, st.name, st.major
ORDER BY `平均成绩` DESC
LIMIT 3
